Name: Optimus
Author: R3coN
Description: Drive the Optimus voice copilot for Star Citizen from your Stream Deck. Keys carry the live state: microphone, emergency stop, simulation.

Actions.Name: Microphone
Actions.Tooltip: Open or close the microphone. The key follows the real state.

Actions.Name: Emergency stop
Actions.Tooltip: Cut every command. The key turns red while it is engaged.

Actions.Name: Simulation
Actions.Tooltip: Resolve and announce commands without touching the keyboard.

Actions.Name: Run a command
Actions.Tooltip: Run one command from the Optimus catalogue, with its guard and its reply. Two states, so the key can show what it last did.

Actions.Name: Speak
Actions.Tooltip: Make the copilot say a line out loud, in its own voice.
